files.purpose: resting place; static empty bed art
loot-item storage chest, distinct from Phase2 card-deck box

design_rules: Independent furniture assets, no full room baked into PNGs.
Position/scale/click-target must be supplied by renderer or separate manifest, not inferred as GAME_RULE from illustration.
For phone landscape, scale objects uniformly with the fixed master canvas; never stretch object aspect ratio.
Asset can be replaced by swapping manifest path without changing game logic.
Actual stash capacity, upgrade cost, effect unlocks, and availability remain governed by v0.5 requirement data; artwork grants no gameplay capability.
